title: Canonical coefficient maps on dualizing and section objects
statement: Let $A,B$ be finite commutative rings in universe $u+1$, let $\phi:A\to B$ be a unital ring homomorphism, and let $g:V\to S$ be a compactifiable morphism of schemes in universe $u$. Work in the ordinary small-etale derived module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $S_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ for the canonical scalar extension used by the exceptional coefficient maps [def-per-exceptional-coefficient-maps], and $G_{R,g}$ for the ordinary compact-support right adjoint [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Put $\omega_{g,R}=G_{R,g}(R_S)$. Define the dualizing coefficient map $c_g:S_V(\omega_{g,A})\to\omega_{g,B}$ to be the specified exceptional counit mate at $A_S$ [def-per-exceptional-coefficient-maps], followed by $G_{B,g}$ of the canonical scalar-unit comparison $S_S(A_S)\cong B_S$ [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations]. For any map $s:S\to V$, use the actual derived inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and put $C_R(g,s)=Ls_R^*\omega_{g,R}$. Define the section coefficient map $q_{g,s}:S_S C_A(g,s)\to C_B(g,s)$ by the inverse scalar/pullback comparison [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso] followed by $Ls_B^*(c_g)$. These are exactly the existing ordinary maps DncCoefficientTransport.dualizingMap and DncCoefficientTransport.sectionMap. They assert no invertibility, smoothness, section identity, normalized deformation transport, or coefficient-flatness property.
